The Reborn

An anti-fossil-fuel extremist faction that drives Compromised's Gulf Coast refinery conflict.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

Conflict over the supply network

The Reborn target the transport and refinery infrastructure that survivor communities rely on, presenting their campaign as a break with fossil-fuel dependence. [1]

Used by rogue agents

Compromised presents the faction as a manipulated actor rather than an isolated Gulf Coast force: rogue agents supply its leadership while steering the regional confrontation toward their own goals. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Compromised identifies the Reborn as the force attacking southern food convoys and advancing on Gulf Coast refinery communities. [1]

  2. confirmed

    The faction's broadcasts frame continuing fossil-fuel production as an offense that must be stopped, making the Groves refinery a primary target. [1]

  3. confirmed

    The novel reveals that the Reborn's leadership accepted military material from rogue agents, who used the faction as part of a wider Gulf Coast manipulation. [1]
